sectionHeadings: 005: Record the whole-project assessment and the proposed adoption plan
B-1. The plan authorizes nothing, and says so in its own text
B-1.1. The plan is reconciled against what has been delivered
B-2. The three milestones stay apart
B-3. Findings carry stable identifiers and separate observation from inference
B-4. External ownership is described, never claimed
B-5. Generated output is governed through its source and its build
record.summary: Owns the three assessment documents under standards/spec: a reconciled whole-project inventory with a dependency-ordered adoption proposal and a current assignment table, a source-backed findings register with stable identifiers, and the traced WAL repair proposal. Records what was measured and what is proposed. It adopts nothing, schedules nothing, enables no gate, and claims no territory outside those three documents.
record.title: Record the whole-project assessment and the proposed adoption plan
